filings.title: Cochin Shipyard Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ' Receipt of order for Normal refit cum re-powering of an Indian Naval Vessel'.
Cochin Shipyard Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Communication on Tax Deduction at Source (TDS) on Dividend payout - 01st Interim Dividend 2026-27'.
Cochin Shipyard Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend is 16-Nov-2026.
Cochin Shipyard Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 10, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 3 per equity share.
Cochin Shipyard Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Cochin Shipyard Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Postal Ballot
Cochin Shipyard Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
